findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
4-903.11: Inspector observed two boxes of cups on the floor in the storage space for Wednesday night meals. The boxes of cups were moved up off of the floor. The violation is considered corrected on site. 

(A) clean EQUIPMENT and clean ARTICLES shall be stored in clean, dry location where they are not exposed to contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment:
Observed utensils(knives, forks, spoons) in tupperware containers stored in multiple directions. Store utensils in the same direction to prevent possible contamination or dispensed with gloves.
750-860 Cleaned and sanitized utensils an equipment shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in a clean, dry location in a way that protects them from contamination by splash, dust and other means.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
1.  The wood bracing the plumbing below the 3-pan sink is raw wood.  Paint the wood so it is non-absorbent and easily cleanable.
2.  There are rusty areas around the faucets on the 3-pan sink.  (REPEAT VIOLATION - recorded as a #37 last inspection).    Sand and seal the rusty areas.                  750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment:
A light bulb was burnt out in the hood over the ovens.  Replace the bulb.

750-1240 All lights in the food prep, food storage or kitchen area of a establishment must be properly shielded (i.e. either have a physical shield or be a shatter resistant bulb) so as to reduce the potential for cross contamination in case of breakage.  Provide properly shielded lights.

findings.comment: 750.800e - Bottom inside the 2 door cooler and the stove top were soiled with food splash. Clean all non-food contact surfaces as needed/after events to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.citation_text: 750.1120 - Hand sanitizer (Germ X) was observed at the kitchen handsink. Hand sanitizer was moved to cabinet below sink by inspector, and a bottle of hand soap was placed at the sink. A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at the handsink. Do not use hand sanitizer as a substitute for soap during the handwashing process or as a substitute for handwashing.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1200 & 1220 - A) Small gaps were observed at the corner by the door to the stove room and behind the stove where two pieces of coving come together. Seal the gaps with caulk. B) Floors were soiled along the wall under the 3 part sink, under single service storage shelves, and in stove room under equipment (dead bugs/debris). Clean the floors as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text: 750.1210 - A) Sink used for coffee/tea prep has a gap around the top seal. Re-seal the coffee/tea prep sink. B) Three part sink has rust formation around faucets, and seams of the sinks are getting rough in some areas. Smooth out the areas and re-seal the seams. C) Counter above dish machine is rough/damaged from heat/water vapor. Repair the counter so it is smooth/easily cleanable.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.citation_text: 750.120 - Open can of pineapple juice was observed in cooler. Can was rusty along top inside and on the lid. Foods shall be protected at all times. High acid foods (i.e. pineapple juice, tomato paste, etc.) must not be stored in the original can once the can is opened - metal/metallic flavors can leak in to the foods and the cans eventually rust. Store canned products in food grade storage containers once cans have been opened to protect foods from potential contamination. Pineapple juice was dumped out during the inspection.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) bakers rack in oven room; B) bottom inside microwave; C) bottom inside 2 door cooler; & D) cabinets below/above coffee maker and under sink at coffee counter. Clean the above items and all non-food contact surfaces as needed to eliminate buildup of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1200 & 1220 - A) Floors were in general soiled with dead bugs along walls and in single service storage area. Floor under/behind ovens and cooler was also soiled. Clean the floors as needed. B) Coving was loose along the top & bottom in some sections of the kitchen and oven room. Also, top corner of coving was pulling away from the wall next to the cabinet in the oven room. C) Gaps/holes were observed in coving on both sides of door leading to the stair well and in the corner by the doors to the oven room. Junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch. Seal loose coving and repair the areas with gaps/holes.
